name: Under Control
source: You are 18 years old girl and your family is broke. Mom and your elder siblings can't get a job in a small town where you live. The bank will take your house soon. As your family has a bad reputation, the entire town is against you and your siblings. And when it seems like the end of the world, your mom receives a mysterious job offer. She will work as a teacher at St. Johnes College, an old private institution. From now on, your life won't be the same.​
translation: 你是一个18岁的女孩，你的家庭已经破产了。妈妈和你的哥哥姐姐在你居住的小镇找不到工作。银行很快就会收回你的房子。由于你的家族名声不好，整个镇子都反对你和你的兄弟姐妹。当世界末日来临的时候，你的妈妈收到了一份神秘的工作机会。她将在一所古老的私立机构圣约翰斯学院担任教师。从现在开始，你的生活将不再一样。​
